records.title: RALLY: Role-Adaptive LLM-Driven Yoked Navigation for Agentic UAV Swarms
records.reason: The abstract is about UAV swarm navigation and mission coverage; its contribution is agent coordination, with no LLM inference or serving optimization.

records.title: Only Large Weights (And Not Skip Connections) Can Prevent the Perils of Rank Collapse
records.reason: Full text establishes a theoretical complexity/expressivity constraint, not a concrete inference optimization: expressive transformers require large weights, constraining when nearly-linear attention is possible. Relevance is indirect background only.

records.title: Scaling and Enhancing LLM-based AVSR: A Sparse Mixture of Projectors Approach
records.reason: Full text reports AVSR quality gains and claims negligible inference overhead but supplies no measured latency, memory, or energy evidence; the specialized speech-task fit is too weak for general inference-efficiency inclusion.
